title: Your First Weekend at Boston University, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Unpack and Meet Your Floor
cards.subtitle: The start of your Terrier journey
cards.notes: Arrive at your assigned residence hall during your scheduled time slot to collect your Terrier Card and begin settling into your new Boston home.
cards.short_summary: Official move-in process for new students to settle into campus housing.
cards.evidence_claim: New student move-in for Fall 2026 is scheduled for Monday, August 24 and Tuesday, August 25.
cards.source_title: Fall 2026 On-Campus Orientation Schedule - Boston University
cards.access_notes: Requires pre-registered move-in time slot via the MyHousing portal.

cards.title: Mind the Step at the Seal
cards.subtitle: A central campus landmark
cards.notes: Walk through the heart of campus but be sure to step around the bronze BU Seal; legend says stepping on it prevents you from graduating in four years.
cards.short_summary: The central plaza of BU, home to a famous student superstition regarding the university seal.
cards.evidence_claim: Legend has it that if you walk across the BU Seal in Marsh Plaza, you will not graduate in four years.
cards.source_title: Why this BU tradition will have you avoiding a piece of Marsh Plaza | Dean of Students
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 as a public outdoor plaza.

cards.title: Fuel Up at Union Court
cards.subtitle: The hub of student life
cards.notes: Grab a meal at the GSU food hall, featuring options like Basho Sushi and Panda Express, while meeting up with new friends between orientation sessions.
cards.short_summary: The primary student union building housing a large food court and student services.
cards.evidence_claim: The George Sherman Union (GSU) is the hub of student life and houses a food court with multiple retail stations.
cards.source_title: George Sherman Union Hours and Information | Dean of Students
cards.access_notes: Building is open daily from 6 am to midnight during the academic year.

cards.title: Lounge at the BU Beach
cards.subtitle: A grassy retreat by the river
cards.notes: Relax on the 'beach'—a grassy knoll behind Marsh Chapel—where the sound of traffic on Storrow Drive mimics the sound of ocean waves.
cards.short_summary: A popular grassy area on campus used for sunbathing and socializing, despite having no sand.
cards.evidence_claim: The BU Beach is a grassy knoll formally known as the Warren Alpert Mall, popular for sunbathing and relaxing.
cards.source_title: Icons Among Us: The BU Beach | BU Today
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor space available during daylight hours.

cards.title: Activate Your Terrier Card
cards.subtitle: World-class fitness facilities
cards.notes: Bring your BU ID to FitRec to activate your membership and explore the pools, climbing wall, and multi-floor gym facilities.
cards.short_summary: The university's primary fitness center, free for full-time students.
cards.evidence_claim: Full-time students have automatic access to FitRec included in tuition; they must sign a waiver on their first visit.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 6 am - 10 pm; weekend hours vary.

cards.title: Find Your Community at Splash
cards.subtitle: The ultimate club recruitment event
cards.notes: Head to Nickerson Field to browse hundreds of student organizations, from club sports to cultural groups, and sign up for mailing lists.
cards.short_summary: BU's massive semiannual fair for student clubs and organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: Splash is BU's club fair held on Nickerson Field on the first Saturday of September during Orientation Week.
cards.source_title: Find Your Club at Splash! | BU Today
cards.access_notes: Typically held from noon to 2:30 pm on the first Saturday of the semester.

cards.title: Scope Out a Study Spot
cards.subtitle: The main campus library
cards.notes: Explore the stacks and find your preferred floor for future study sessions; the higher floors offer quieter environments for deep focus.
cards.short_summary: The primary research library for the Charles River Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Mugar Memorial Library is the largest library on campus and offers various study spaces including reservable rooms.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight most nights; requires BU ID for entry after hours.

cards.title: Stroll the Riverfront Path
cards.subtitle: Scenic views of the Boston skyline
cards.notes: Cross the footbridge near the BU Beach to access the Esplanade for a walk or run along the Charles River with views of Cambridge.
cards.short_summary: A long riverside park accessible via pedestrian bridges from the BU campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Esplanade stretches along the Charles River and is accessible from BU via pedestrian footbridges.
cards.access_notes: Open from dawn to dusk daily.

cards.title: Explore Art for Free
cards.subtitle: World-class museum access
cards.notes: Take a short trip to the MFA and use your BU ID for free admission to explore one of the most comprehensive art collections in the world.
cards.short_summary: A major art museum offering free admission to BU students.
cards.evidence_claim: BU students receive free membership and admission to the Museum of Fine Arts, Boston with a valid BU Student ID.
cards.source_title: Art Memberships & Discounts | Office for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Check MFA website for current hours; typically closed Tuesdays.

cards.title: Catch a Terrier Event
cards.subtitle: Home of BU Hockey
cards.notes: Visit the arena to pick up your student sports pass or attend a welcome event to experience the energy of the Terrier community.
cards.short_summary: A multi-purpose arena that serves as the home for BU hockey and major campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: Agganis Arena is the place for first-year students to show BU pride and use their Sports Pass for athletic events.
cards.access_notes: Event times vary; ticket office is located at 925 Commonwealth Ave.
